steps.text:
The rollback was caused by commit **5ad0b3e**, written by **sam.r**.

- **Deployment:** dep-4815 (v1.9.3) for payments-worker (svc-payworker). It started in production at 2026-10-23T16:40:27Z and its status is `rolled_back`. It replaced commit 3e1f2d0.
- **The change:** commit 5ad0b3e, "Lower ledger client timeout from 2s to 200ms" (PR #412 in acme/payments-worker). It changed one file, `src/ledger/client.rs`, cutting the timeout from `Duration::from_secs(2)` to `Duration::from_millis(200)`.
- **Who:** sam.r wrote the commit and also triggered the deployment.
- **What the logs show:** at 16:44:02Z the deployment logged "ledger-service call timed out after 200ms (retry budget exhausted)". At 16:44:05Z the circuit breaker opened for ledger-service. That points to the shorter timeout as the cause of the rollback.

My first attempt to look up the commit failed only because I passed an extra `repo` argument the tool doesn't accept. It worked once I removed it.
